headword: {共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}
reading: きょうどうけんきゅう

definitions.explanation: Research carried out jointly by two or more people, institutions, or companies working together toward a common goal.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}と{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: to conduct joint research with a university

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}との{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Joint research with a company has begun.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}の{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}との{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}で、{新|あたら}しい{材料|ざいりょう}が{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: A new material was developed through joint research with an overseas institute.

notes:
Research conducted collaboratively by multiple parties. Built from {共同|きょうどう} (joint; shared) and {研究|けんきゅう} (research).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out joint research
- {産学|さんがく}{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}: industry-academia joint research
- {共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}{者|しゃ}: a co-researcher; research collaborator

RELATED WORDS:
- {共同|きょうどう}: joint; collaborative
- {研究|けんきゅう}: research; study
